Hyperparameters are tuned on the development set of each dataset.

retrieved.content: Table shows the experimental results for MRC tasks. With either BERT or XLNet, our proposed DSC loss obtains significant performance boost on both EM and F1. For SQuADv1.1, our proposed method outperforms XLNet by +1.25 in terms of F1 score and +0.84 in terms of EM and achieves 87.65 on EM and 89.51 on F1 for SQuAD v2.0. Moreover, on QuoRef, the proposed method surpasses XLNet results by +1.46 on EM and +1.41 on F1. Another observation is that, XLNet outperforms BERT by a huge margin, and the proposed DSC loss can obtain further performance improvement by an average score above 1.0 in terms of both EM and F1, which indicates the DSC loss is complementary to the model structures.
